description: Reconcile local master with PR #9; preserve and inspect dirty overlay, restore required Git-first implementation, repair reproducible failures, validate, commit and push verified work.

acceptance_criteria: Same project identity and canonical records work across moved clones and linked worktrees without checkout path becoming durable identity.
Repeated checkout and branch changes refresh the local projection and fence stale writers.
Same-checkout concurrent writes use revision checks, atomic publication, and explicit conflicts; independent records remain isolated.
Offline clone claims remain advisory; synchronized competing attempts trigger conflict handling and re-review; private leases and receipts never enter Git.
Updater performs bounded, restartable, idempotent, snapshot-validated one-time migration with recoverable cutover.
After cutover, no legacy runtime readers/writers, fallbacks, dual writes, manual batch operations, or compatibility shims remain.
Real Git tests cover moved checkouts, linked worktrees, independent clones, stale/disjoint concurrent writes, branch-switch fencing, migration resume/rollback, and rejection of legacy runtime paths.
task_pr9_complete.blocker: Agent OS task has no persisted session_id, so receipt-gated completion and plan_reconcile_steering remain unavailable. Continue implementation and validation; do not claim plan completion without authentic receipts.
